rules: Group 2 stores absolute patient measurements for the middle-finger phalanges.
D2-D5 lengths equal the matching middle-finger reference times a calibrated factor plus the optional zero-based per-digit difference.
Palmar-arc master zero means zero metacarpal X rotation before fine curvature.
MCP 2+2 opening is a Z rotation around each metacarpal base, never a lateral translation.
Radial-ulnar wrist deviation belongs to the main wrist/opening panel.
Legacy wrist flexion starts neutral in V3.1.
